where: Umbral Spire summit (the Great Null, Warden Còr, the Keystar)
mood: Crown of Null: the summit under the Keystar; grave, sorrowful grandeur and driving resolve, the hometown motif boomed in minor and promised its major.
core_styles: A minor turning to A major
layered pulse-wave lead booming a noble minor melody
solemn pipe organ and warm reverbed string chords
full driving drums with timpani rolls and crash cymbals
tragic, grave and courageous, sorrow and resolve

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {dread at the summit: a deep tolling low bell and timpani roll, a vast organ chord swells, and the lead slowly booms the first rising notes of the main theme in minor, landing on a held dominant that snaps into the drive}
styles: sense of standing before something vast

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the noble minor melody boomed on the layered lead over driving bass and drums, a rising leap then a sorrowful stepwise fall, grave and unforgettable}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with the second lead answering each phrase and organ chords filling out, drums pounding harder}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the clouds break, the harmony turns to radiant A major, the same melody rising triumphant with a bright harp sweep and crash cymbal, a promise of dawn, then darkening back toward the minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the minor melody returns grave and driving; the last bar drives on the dominant straight back into the main theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
